Area.evidence_source: This theory about suffering and health is chosen because it thoroughly discusses the ontological dimension of suffering. Here, suffering is described as life suffering, suffering from disease and suffering in the absence of care. Life suffering linked to human existence seems particularly central as an interpretation frame for this study. Suffering from disease is about consequences of disease, while suffering in the absence of care is related to treatment and care. Suffering can be relieved when man's dignity is affirmed (17–19). Dignity is seen as being inherent, as an inner ethical attitude (19).
